source_document.body:
The Hidden Cost-to-Serve in Packaged Goods explores how these everyday exceptions consume labor, capacity, and coordination, and what leaders can do about them.
This G3 Logistics whitepaper offers a practical approach to measuring hidden costs, aligning sales, operations, and finance, and turning recurring workarounds into intentional service decisions. Discover the G3 Exception to Value Framework for deciding when to absorb, redesign, price, or decline a request.
Download the whitepaper to uncover hidden costs and make more informed decisions that protect margin and customer experience.
